metadata.description: Personal set of Claude Code mods, pinned to reviewed upstream commits.

plugins.description: Progress band and live subagents panel.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Themes, richer tool rows and cards; /skin switches them.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: File tree pane showing what Claude reads and writes.

plugins.description: Finds reusable corrections in your prompts and saves them to CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the last turn's file edits one diff at a time.
